_about: H7604 repair-manual page assets in two representations. 300dpi/ are FLATTENED page renders (photo + vector callouts composited) from pypdfium2 at scale=300/72 over a 960x540pt page. native/ are the raw embedded image objects (original encoding, w>=64 & h>=64) WITHOUT the manual's vector callouts/labels (those are overlaid separately, lost in native). Native dims cap recoverable photo detail (board shots ~1149x762); re-rendering the page at higher DPI adds NO new photo detail, only sharper vector text, so a 600 DPI set is not retained. dup_of flags chrome repeated across pages. sha256 is the committed-file checksum.
source: ASUS ProArt StudioBook W7604J/N7604J/H7604J series repair manual (26pp).
